content.comment_body: Hello! I have a quick question regarding [product_name] software. Is it possible to use [product_name] to display graphs, such as plotting analog values over time? I've checked online and in the forum but remain uncertain, maybe it's achievable through additional software. Thanks!
Currently, there are two graphic elements available for analog values: an analog bar and an analog slider.
